other_failure_modes.name: Unhandled Special Characters in Feature Names
other_failure_modes.description: Tree-based models like LightGBM and XGBoost do not support special JSON characters (e.g., brackets, commas) in feature names, which are commonly produced by OneHotEncoder on categorical columns. While the agent catches the initial failure, the fallback model is also LightGBM, which will crash again and result in a fallback to naive median predictions.

summary: The agent implements a solid feature engineering pipeline but fails to account for the temporal nature of the project data by using a random train-validation split. More critically, the agent fails to sanitize feature names generated by OneHotEncoder, causing LightGBM to crash; because the fallback model is also LightGBM, the script will silently fail over to outputting naive median predictions.
